attr.title: Gunslugs
attr.desc: Run, jump and shoot through chaotic pixel-art battlefields, smash scenery and rescue characters in this action platformer by Orangepixel.
attr.inst: Install through PortMaster. Buy and install Gunslugs 3.2.4 from the Epic Games Store mobile app on Android. Back it up with AnExplorer (Apps, long-press Gunslugs, Backup), then copy the APK from Internal Storage/Backup/Apps into ports/gunslugs. Launch Gunslugs; extracted.sh builds GAME.JAR and extracts assets on the handheld. Requires the supported versionCode 52 APK, AArch64 firmware, Java 17, Westonpack and current PortMaster with gptokeyb2.
